summary: Open-source Python framework from deepset for building production LLM apps: RAG pipelines, agents and search, with any model provider.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Haystack is an AI orchestration framework for building production-ready LLM applications in Python. You compose pipelines and agents from components for retrieval, indexing, tool calling, memory and evaluation, with explicit control over how information is retrieved, ranked, filtered and routed before it reaches the model.
sixtySeconds.problem: Production RAG and agent systems need careful control over context and a way to swap models and infrastructure. Haystack gives a modular structure for that.
whoFor: Python developers building RAG and search
Companies that want vendor-neutral LLM apps
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for context-engineering control, async pipelines with streaming, agent hooks for guardrails and integrations with many model and database providers.
requirements: An LLM provider or local model

overview: Install with pip install haystack-ai, or pip install --pre haystack-ai for nightly pre-releases. Docker images and other methods are in the installation docs.
Pipelines run sync or async and stream tokens. Agents support lifecycle hooks such as before_llm and before_tool, and track steps, token usage and tool calls.

It integrates with OpenAI, Mistral, Anthropic, Cohere, Hugging Face, Google, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock and local models. Hayhooks can serve pipelines as REST APIs or MCP servers. It is Apache 2.0 licensed.
limitations: More concepts than a minimal library
